sayLines.text: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Felix.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 3 people, 25 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 1 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Esther speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Extended Warranty is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Esther speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1300 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Esther speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Stonebridge, Thornfield, Ashford count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)

◈ SYSTEM: "58. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,030 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
